id.description: The unique identifier of the model

modelType.description: The name of the meta model, e.g. application, document, form, overview, relationship, tree

modelVersion.description: The version of the meta model

locales.description: All supported locales of the model

labels.description:
All labels of the model

A label of a model is a text that can be used to display the model to users for a given locale

annotations.description:
All annotations of the model

An annotation is a key value pair of strings which can contain any project specific extension.

Header.description: Contains common header information for all types of A12 models.

LocalizedModelText.description:
An array containing the translations for a given model element (property), e.g. a label.

Each array item contains the translation for a single (partial) locale.

locale.description:
The serialized representation of the (partial) locale.

Expected format: \<language\>[_\<COUNTRY\>]

Valid examples: en_US, de_DE, fr

Invalid examples: en-US, en_us, enUS, FR

text.description: The localized text for the given locale.

LocalizedText.description: An object representing a key-value mapping of locale -> localized text for a specific model property

purpose.description: A string containing what the references is used for

modelType.description: A string containing what (meta) model type is referenced e.g. document, form, overview, application, tree, relationship

alias.description: A string which can be used inside of the model to refer to this model reference

reference.description: The actual reference to the other model

ModelReference.description: A model reference contains information about references of a model to other models.
